title: Hinemos Agent Improper Certificate Validation Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. (CVE-2026-126963)
description: CVE-2026-126963 is a remote code execution vulnerability in the Hinemos Agent caused by improper validation of server certificates. This flaw allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code without authentication by exploiting the agent's failure to properly validate certificates presented by servers. The vulnerability affects the Hinemos Agent service and can lead to full compromise of the service account.
